name: Columns, trays and structured packing
principle: A fractionating column separates liquids by volatility; vapour and liquid contact on trays or packing. Packing gives low pressure drop, which suits vacuum service.

process_steps.name: Vapour rises and liquid descends over trays or packing
Overhead condensed; part returned as reflux
